name: search-object
title: Search for an object
description: Find an object whose location is unknown: visit the supports of a room in order of distance and aim the head at each surface until the object is seen.
use_when: The location of an object is unknown in the current room.

not_to_be_confused_with.explore: explore covers a room without a target.

region.description: Room to search; default the robot's room.

found_on.description: Support under the object when it was seen.

postconditions.name: observed
postconditions.meaning: The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: observed
checks.meaning: The robot saw the target in its head camera during this episode (set by look, search, inspect, explore).
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

previous.when: a specific object must then be located

next.when: the found object must be fetched

fallback.when: the object is not on any visited support
fallback.reason: room coverage marks every visible object observed, including the target

fallback.when: the object may be inside a closed cabinet

fallback_for.when: the object is not where expected

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
